queries.name: the controller ON event is 21:32 after correction
queries.sql: select to_char(controller_at + interval '3 minutes', 'HH24:MI') from power_controller_log where controller_event_id = 'P2'

queries.name: the rear-door motion is 21:32 after correction
queries.sql: select to_char(camera_at - interval '4 minutes', 'HH24:MI') from corridor_camera_events where camera_event_id = 'C9'

queries.name: the player-facing controller log never names Rohit
queries.sql: select count(*) from power_controller_log where actor_hint ilike '%rohit%'

queries.name: only one door skips RFID
queries.sql: select count(*) from building_access_points where records_rfid = false
